summary: Iteration 7 — pipeline_status + cover uploads + KDP metadata. Backend pytest 17/17 NEW + 22/22 regression (upload_export + ai_editorial) = 100% pass. Frontend flows all functionally work BUT the React dev server is showing a 'Compiled with problems' error overlay (ESLint: rule 'react-hooks/exhaustive-deps' not found) that intercepts clicks on real user sessions. After programmatically removing the overlay iframe, every UI flow passes: pipeline badges + progress text, meta-save toast, cover upload + preview + remove, dashboard cover-thumb + description preference.

ui_bugs.issue: ESLint compile error overlay blocks the entire UI in dev: '[eslint] src/pages/EditorPage.js Line 727:5: Definition for rule react-hooks/exhaustive-deps was not found react-hooks/exhaustive-deps'. The overlay (iframe#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay) sits on top of the page and intercepts clicks — users cannot click meta-save-btn or cover-remove-btn until they dismiss the overlay. Production `yarn build` will likely fail with the same error. ROOT CAUSE: the file contains `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` at line 727 but the eslint config (CRA's eslint-config-react-app) is not registering the react-hooks plugin in this workspace, so the rule name is unknown and ESLint reports it as a hard error. FIX: either install/enable eslint-plugin-react-hooks in the frontend config OR remove the unrecognized disable-line comment (the lint suppression is no longer needed).

action_items: HIGH: Remove the orphaned `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` comment in /app/frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.js around line 727 (and any other occurrences) OR add eslint-plugin-react-hooks back into the eslint config so the rule is recognized. The current state causes a full-screen red CRA error overlay that blocks meta-save-btn and cover-remove-btn clicks for real users.

_compute_pipeline_status (server.py line 182) calls find_cover_upload and find_audio_upload (filesystem scans) for EVERY doc on the list endpoint. Acceptable for now but O(N) disk hits per request — consider caching cover_image_ext on the doc record (already done for cover) and a similar `audiobook_uploaded` flag to avoid the audio scan on /api/documents list, or batch-list per-user upload dirs once.
Cover upload validates extension only; no magic-byte check. The tests intentionally pass synthetic non-image bytes with .jpg extension and get 200 — matches the spec but worth a comment for security.
save_cover_upload uses synchronous Path.write_bytes inside an async endpoint; fine for ≤10 MB but use asyncio.to_thread for consistency.

rca of the issue: FRONTEND OVERLAY BUG: The CRA dev server is rendering a full-viewport red 'Compiled with problems' overlay because ESLint cannot resolve the rule 'react-hooks/exhaustive-deps' referenced in a `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` directive at EditorPage.js:727. This implies eslint-plugin-react-hooks is not registered in the active ESLint config (likely missing from CRA's eslintConfig in package.json or removed from node_modules). Two viable fixes: (1) delete the unrecognized disable-line comment(s) since the warning it suppresses isn't being emitted anyway; (2) re-add `eslint-plugin-react-hooks` and ensure CRA's `react-app` shareable config includes it. Option (1) is faster and unblocks both the dev overlay AND any `yarn build` failure. Reproduction: open any /editor/:id page in a browser without overriding the overlay — observe red overlay covering the page, then try to click data-testid='meta-save-btn' → click is intercepted (no toast, no save).
